# ruff: noqa: F821
# graph_headroom — evolution seed for the dev-continuum-* family.  Identity stays
# outside EVOLVE-BLOCKs; Shinka operators may change only the implementation below.
#
# Why this seed and not `least_allocated` (the dev-medium-hot seed): on this family the
# dependency-blind policies are *infeasible* (worst SLO 0.88 against a 0.90 target), so
# seeding from one would start every arm outside the feasible region and turn the first
# half of every campaign into a feasibility hunt rather than a search.  This seed is the
# most SLO-margined feasible hand-written policy (0.95); it is also the *expensive* one
# (1.27 normalized energy against `latency_greedy`'s 0.83), which is deliberate — the
# search starts feasible and has an explicit, large energy gap to close rather than
# starting at the best baseline with nowhere to go.
POLICY_NAME: str = "graph_headroom"
POLICY_VERSION: str = "1.0.0"

# EVOLVE-BLOCK-START

    return -float(node.id)

def propose_moves(state: ClusterState, graph: CallGraphCtx, budget: int) -> list[Move]:
    out: list[Move] = []
    return out
# EVOLVE-BLOCK-END

# ruff: noqa: F821
# graph_headroom — evolution seed for the dev-continuum-* family.  Identity stays
# outside EVOLVE-BLOCKs; Shinka operators may change only the implementation below.
#
# Why this seed and not `least_allocated` (the dev-medium-hot seed): on this family the
# dependency-blind policies are *infeasible* (worst SLO 0.88 against a 0.90 target), so
# seeding from one would start every arm outside the feasible region and turn the first
# half of every campaign into a feasibility hunt rather than a search.  This seed is the
# most SLO-margined feasible hand-written policy (0.95); it is also the *expensive* one
# (1.27 normalized energy against `latency_greedy`'s 0.83), which is deliberate — the
# search starts feasible and has an explicit, large energy gap to close rather than
# starting at the best baseline with nowhere to go.
POLICY_NAME: str = "graph_headroom"
POLICY_VERSION: str = "1.0.0"

# EVOLVE-BLOCK-START
def proximity_of(mean_latency_ms: float) -> float:
    scaled = mean_latency_ms / 45.0
    return 1.0 - min(scaled, 1.0)

def node_util(node: NodeState) -> float:
    cpu_cap = float(max(node.cpu_capacity, 1))
    mem_cap = float(max(node.mem_capacity, 1))
    cpu = float(node.cpu_allocated) / cpu_cap
    mem = float(node.mem_allocated) / mem_cap
    return max(cpu, mem)

def node_util_after(pod: Pod, node: NodeState) -> float:
    cpu_cap = float(max(node.cpu_capacity, 1))
    mem_cap = float(max(node.mem_capacity, 1))
    cpu = float(node.cpu_allocated + pod.cpu_request) / cpu_cap
    mem = float(node.mem_allocated + pod.mem_request) / mem_cap
    return max(cpu, mem)

def node_power(node: NodeState, cpu_alloc: int, mem_alloc: int) -> float:
    cpu_cap = float(max(node.cpu_capacity, 1))
    mem_cap = float(max(node.mem_capacity, 1))
    cpu = float(cpu_alloc) / cpu_cap
    mem = float(mem_alloc) / mem_cap
    u = max(cpu, mem)
    dyn = node.power_max_w - node.power_idle_w
    return node.power_idle_w + dyn * u

def move_energy_gain(pod: Pod, src_node: NodeState, dst_node: NodeState) -> float:
    src_cpu_before = src_node.cpu_allocated
    src_mem_before = src_node.mem_allocated
    dst_cpu_before = dst_node.cpu_allocated
    dst_mem_before = dst_node.mem_allocated
    src_cpu_after = src_cpu_before - pod.cpu_request
    src_mem_after = src_mem_before - pod.mem_request
    dst_cpu_after = dst_cpu_before + pod.cpu_request
    dst_mem_after = dst_mem_before + pod.mem_request
    before = node_power(src_node, src_cpu_before, src_mem_before) + node_power(dst_node, dst_cpu_before, dst_mem_before)
    after = node_power(src_node, src_cpu_after, src_mem_after) + node_power(dst_node, dst_cpu_after, dst_mem_after)
    return before - after

def contains(ids: list[int], pid: int) -> bool:
    n = len(ids)
    for i in range(n):
        if ids[i] == pid:
            return True
    return False

def edge_proximity(pod: Pod, node: NodeState, ctx: ClusterCtx) -> float:
    weighted = 0.0
    weight = 0.0
    edges = len(ctx.graph.src)
    for e in range(edges):
        source = ctx.graph.src[e]
        destination = ctx.graph.dst[e]
        other = -1
        if source == pod.id:
            other = destination
        if destination == pod.id:
            other = source
        if other >= 0 and other != pod.id:
            neighbor = ctx.pods[other]
            if neighbor.current_node >= 0:
                rate = ctx.graph.rate[e]
                weighted = weighted + rate * node.latency_to_ms[neighbor.current_node]
                weight = weight + rate
    if weight <= 0.0:
        return 0.5
    return proximity_of(weighted / weight)

def score(pod: Pod, node: NodeState, ctx: ClusterCtx) -> float:
    if node.suspended:
        return -1000000.0
    peak_after = node_util_after(pod, node)
    if peak_after > 0.88:
        return -1000000.0
    util = node_util(node)
    cpu_cap = float(max(node.cpu_capacity, 1))
    mem_cap = float(max(node.mem_capacity, 1))
    cpu_frac = float(pod.cpu_request) / cpu_cap
    mem_frac = float(pod.mem_request) / mem_cap
    frac = max(cpu_frac, mem_frac)
    dyn = node.power_max_w - node.power_idle_w
    marginal = dyn * frac
    if node.cpu_allocated <= 0 and node.mem_allocated <= 0:
        marginal = marginal + node.power_idle_w
    energy_cost = min(marginal / 100.0, 1.0)
    energy_score = 1.0 - energy_cost
    proximity = edge_proximity(pod, node, ctx)
    return proximity * 0.35 + util * 0.45 + energy_score * 0.20

def propose_moves(state: ClusterState, graph: CallGraphCtx, budget: int) -> list[Move]:
    out: list[Move] = []
    if budget <= 0:
        return out
    moved = 0
    moved_ids: list[int] = []
    used_targets: list[int] = []
    edges = len(graph.src)
    for e in range(edges):
        if moved >= budget:
            return out
        sp = state.pods[graph.src[e]]
        dp = state.pods[graph.dst[e]]
        sp_placed = sp.current_node >= 0
        dp_placed = dp.current_node >= 0
        same_node = sp.current_node == dp.current_node
        edge_ok = sp_placed and dp_placed and not same_node
        if edge_ok:
            src_node = state.nodes[sp.current_node]
            dst_node = state.nodes[dp.current_node]
            src_util = node_util(src_node)
            dst_util = node_util(dst_node)
            if src_util <= dst_util:
                can_sp = sp_placed and not sp.stateful and not sp.has_pdb
                can_sp = can_sp and not contains(moved_ids, sp.id)
                can_sp = can_sp and not dst_node.suspended
                can_sp = can_sp and not contains(used_targets, dst_node.id)
                if can_sp:
                    after = node_util_after(sp, dst_node)
                    if after < 0.88:
                        gain = move_energy_gain(sp, src_node, dst_node)
                        if gain > 0.0:
                            out.append(move_pod(sp.id, dp.current_node))
                            moved = moved + 1
                            moved_ids.append(sp.id)
                            used_targets.append(dst_node.id)
            else:
                can_dp = dp_placed and not dp.stateful and not dp.has_pdb
                can_dp = can_dp and not contains(moved_ids, dp.id)
                can_dp = can_dp and not src_node.suspended
                can_dp = can_dp and not contains(used_targets, src_node.id)
                if can_dp:
                    after = node_util_after(dp, src_node)
                    if after < 0.88:
                        gain = move_energy_gain(dp, dst_node, src_node)
                        if gain > 0.0:
                            out.append(move_pod(dp.id, sp.current_node))
                            moved = moved + 1
                            moved_ids.append(dp.id)
                            used_targets.append(src_node.id)
    return out
# EVOLVE-BLOCK-END
